facts.fact: Bubba 下台后第二年，作者再次就同一批问题向 AFSCME 提出对 Stein 的指控
facts.anchor: I filed similar charges against Stein with AFSCME.

facts.fact: 不公平劳动实践指控的听证日，作者当面在 Stein 与公园局官员面前陈述并出示证据
facts.anchor: I presented in front of Stein and Parks Department officials.

facts.fact: 2023 年阵亡将士节时，全市在岗救生员只有五百人，而满负荷需要一千五百人以上
facts.anchor: it only had five hundred lifeguards on hand

facts.fact: 公园局一拖再拖，直到 7 月 4 日后才通知作者去 59 街泳池上五天复训班
facts.anchor: they finally told me to come in after July Fourth

facts.fact: 2022 年 6 月，姐姐 Helen 在 108 街看到少女下水，拨打 911 叫救生员
facts.anchor: she called 911 to get lifeguards to the beach

facts.fact: 当晚得知那名被离岸流卷走的少女溺亡
facts.anchor: one of the girls had died

facts.fact: 听证开庭前两周，Stein 以退休为最后一招退场
facts.anchor: Stein pulled one last move—he retired

facts.fact: 工会司法委员会认定其违反章程，却只对 Stein 一方作出正式训诫
facts.anchor: they just issued a formal reprimand to Stein and his men
